scope: C-02 Finding #1 and Finding #2: preserve email-bound unregistered-recipient continuation while requiring independent Membership/Invitation CAS versions and mapped fail-closed A7/A8 readiness.

knownBlockers.evidence: The operation map is documented and the runtime default is deny-by-default. No production A7 provider/proof or A8 cutover evidence source is wired into IAM.

cases.scenario: Invite an email that already belongs to an eligible account
cases.expectedCandidate: Invitation creation is valid; recipient still signs in and uses normal email-bound acceptance.

cases.scenario: Invite a syntactically valid email that has no account at invitation time
cases.expectedCandidate: Invitation creation is valid and creates no User, Membership, RoleAssignment, or Organization session.

cases.scenario: Register and verify an account using the invited email, then resume the invitation
cases.expectedCandidate: The optional returnToInvitationId carries a non-secret navigation reference only. After normal sign-in, the server reloads and validates the invitation; acceptance requires expectedMembershipVersion=0 and the current expectedInvitationVersion plus the normal authorization, email-binding, lifecycle and readiness checks.

cases.scenario: The registered/authenticated account email differs from the invitation email
cases.expectedCandidate: Reject invitation read/acceptance for the mismatched account; the ID does not transfer the invitation or grant membership.
Reject fail-closed; no Membership is created.
Reject without returning protected Organization data or creating a Membership.

cases.scenario: Attempt to use an invitation owned by Organization A as an invitation for Organization B
cases.expectedCandidate: Reject scope substitution; invitation ownership and all authorization remain server-derived.

cases.scenario: Attempt to use a generic copied/shared Organization join link
cases.expectedCandidate: Unsupported. Each emailed credential is for one invitation and one recipient email; no multi-user bearer link exists.

cases.scenario: Invitation lifecycle concurrency preconditions include both versions
cases.expectedCandidate: ACCEPT, RESEND and CANCEL require expectedMembershipVersion=0 for a V3 pending invitation with no Membership row, alongside the independently checked positive expectedInvitationVersion. Stale MV or IV returns 409 and leaves invitation/Membership state unchanged.

CREATE/RESEND require A7_NOTIFICATION_CONTRACT_PROVIDER+A8_COORDINATED_CUTOVER; CANCEL requires A8_COORDINATED_CUTOVER; ACCEPT requires A7_LEGACY_OR_ORPHAN_RIGHTS_ACTIVATION_PROOF+A8_COORDINATED_CUTOVER. NOT READY returns 503 before lifecycle writes.

cases.scenario: CANCEL races with ACCEPT using the same expected versions
cases.expectedCandidate: At most one transaction commits. If CANCEL wins, the invitation remains CANCELLED and no Membership is activated; a concurrent stale ACCEPT returns 409. If ACCEPT wins, the invitation is ACCEPTED with one ACTIVE Membership and stale CANCEL returns 409.
